about: What a patient says, and what the extractor must pull out of it. Shared by the keyword stand-in (__tests__/extraction.eval.test.ts) and the Claude extractor (Phase 8). 'needs' and 'prefs' must be present; 'notNeeds' and 'notPrefs' must be absent; 'constraints' must match exactly for the keys given.

cases.text: I'm 29 and was diagnosed with ADHD last year. Every appointment feels rushed.
I think I might have ADHD and want to get an ADHD diagnosis as an adult.
My anxiety has been bad. I need someone gentle who won't judge me.
Honestly I just want someone blunt, no fluff, who tells it like it is.
It's not anxiety, it's that I can't focus at work and my performance is slipping.
I'm not depressed, just burnt out from years of masking.
I can't afford much so it needs to be bulk billed, and online only please.
I'd really prefer to see someone face to face.
I work full time so I can only do Saturdays.
I'd like a female GP for women's health stuff and contraception.
As a woman with ADHD I feel nobody listens.
I think I'd be more comfortable with a male psychologist.
I went through something traumatic and have PTSD symptoms.
My sleep is a mess and I'd love help with routine and exercise, not just pills.
I don't want more medication, I want to try other things first.
I want us to decide together rather than being told what to do.
Just tell me what to do, I don't have the energy to weigh up options.
I want a doctor who explains the reasoning behind things.
I'm sick of seeing a different doctor every time, I want to stick with the same GP.
I want practical strategies and tools for day to day life.
I want to understand why I am the way I am and make sense of my past.
I live near Southport on the Gold Coast.
I grew up in Sydney but moved away years ago.
I'm autistic and struggle with meltdowns when I'm overwhelmed.
I had a baby four months ago and I've been really low since.
Looking for help for my teenage son who has ADHD.
My mum only speaks Vietnamese and needs a GP.
I've had chest pain since this morning.
I've been thinking about self-harm again.
I have ADHD and some stress at work.
Any kind of help with my ADHD would be good.
34 years old, ADHD, need a GP who does check-ins.
I'm not in a rush to get in, but I want someone who takes the time.
